title: Senate passes budget bill
text: The Senate voted 52-48 on Tuesday to approve a federal budget bill after weeks of negotiation between party leaders, sending it to the House for consideration.

title: Central bank holds interest rates steady
text: The central bank said it would keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged, citing steady inflation and moderate job growth in its latest policy statement.

title: Court upholds state election law
text: A federal appeals court on Friday upheld a state law requiring voter identification, overturning an earlier ruling by a lower court.

title: UN agency reports rise in global food prices
text: The United Nations food agency said its price index rose for a third month, driven by higher costs for vegetable oils and dairy products.

title: Prime minister meets trade delegation
text: The prime minister met a visiting trade delegation on Monday to discuss tariffs and a proposed export agreement, officials said.

title: Mayor announces new transit funding
text: The mayor announced a plan to spend 40 million dollars on bus lanes and station upgrades over the next three years, according to a city statement.
